messages: I met a fairy in #m10002000# that was busily studying the magic of life. Her name was Mar, and she took a look at the lifeless doll that was once my pet for me. She can bring it back to life with a #b#t5180000##k and a #b#t4031034##k. I hear that she knows #p219# of #m010001000#... A pet trainer named #b#p222##k in #b#m010001000##k might know something about the scroll of life, so I should start there...

After easily passing the test #p222# of #m010001000# gave me, I got a hold of the #b#t5180000##k and #b#t4031034##k and got them to #p317#. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now... Sweet...
name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life
